description: Google Search Console: SEO audits, performance queries, URL inspection, indexing checks.
name: io.github.acamolese/google-search-console-mcp

environmentVariables.description: OAuth client ID from a Desktop app credential in Google Cloud Console.
environmentVariables.name: GSC_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: OAuth client secret paired with GSC_CLIENT_ID.
environmentVariables.name: GSC_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Path to a service account JSON key, as an alternative to OAuth.
environmentVariables.name: GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Language of the generated HTML audit report: en or it. Defaults to en.
environmentVariables.name: GSC_REPORT_LANGUAGE

environmentVariables.description: Default freshness of the data: all (includes today's partial data) or final.
environmentVariables.name: GSC_DATA_STATE

title: Google Search Console
